d:
A lawyer approached the Supreme Court alleging that airfares in India have increased by as much as 700 per cent. During the hearing on November 2, Justice Vikram Nath responded, “Don't travel by air,” when the lawyer raised concerns over expensive flight tickets.
The petitioner invoked Article 14 of the Constitution, arguing that steep airfare hikes violate the right to equality. The issue comes amid growing concerns over dynamic airline pricing and rising ticket costs during festivals and emergencies.
